admissibility_order.confirmation_bank_prohibition: The admissibility order is evaluated on the development split only. The confirmation split is physically inaccessible until an interface has been proposed, the proposal has been sealed, and a separate authority has released it.
admissibility_order.denominator_rule: The Family B Bonferroni denominator is 3 under every outcome, including the outcome in which S3's multi-token activation condition is not met and S3 is skipped. Finding S3MR-016 recorded that draft-v0.2 corrected over 3 while also declaring S3 conditionally unavailable, which would have tested 2 profiles at a level computed for 3. Shrinking the denominator after seeing which profiles are available would be a data-dependent relaxation of the level and is prohibited.
admissibility_order.eligibility_rule: An interface profile is eligible if and only if every gate that is applicable to it passes in every atomic cell. The applicable gate set is a property of the profile and is listed in the profile. I4 is part of eligibility.
admissibility_order.executable_selection_map: studies/study3/analysis/design_statistics.py, function development_selection; all 16 pre-data scenarios are enumerated in design_statistics_tables.json under development_selection_map
admissibility_order.i1b_applicability: I1b is required for label-bearing profiles only. For content-only profiles it is not_applicable, which is neither a pass nor a waiver: the profile simply has no symbol-binding step to validate.
admissibility_order.i3_applicability: the seven K5 contrast cells are not_applicable to S2 and S3 and the two K6 contrast cells are applicable to every profile. not_applicable is never a pass and never contributes to eligibility.
admissibility_order.no_winner_this_round_statement: No interface is selected in this round.

admissibility_order.principle: A pre-registered, fail-closed admissibility order replaces the data-dependent ranking used in draft-v0.1. The order is fixed here, before any data exists, so that no outcome can influence which surface is preferred. Data can only remove candidates from the order; it can never reorder them.
admissibility_order.study_stops_only_when: no selectable interface remains eligible. The failure of one interface eliminates that interface and nothing else.
admissibility_order.what_happens_if_the_highest_ranked_eligi: nothing automatic; the admissibility order simply proposes the highest-ranked eligible surface. A proposal is not a selection, and this round makes no selection.

atomic_evaluation_cells.cluster_rule: Every permutation, label-set replacement and rendering variant derived from one base item belongs to the same correlated cluster as that base item, is assigned to the same split as that base item, and is never treated as an independent observation. Splitting a cluster across splits would leak the confirmation set.
atomic_evaluation_cells.definition: An atomic evaluation cell is one combination of interface profile, checkpoint role, task stratum, contrast family, contrast ID, operation family, depth, rendering, label alphabet and split, restricted to the factors that are applicable to the gate being evaluated. A gate passes only if it passes in every atomic cell to which it is applicable.
atomic_evaluation_cells.descriptive_pooling: Pooled summaries may be reported for readability. They carry no gate authority, may never be substituted for a failed cell, and must be labelled descriptive wherever they appear.
atomic_evaluation_cells.evaluation_cell_definition: an evaluation cell is one sampling cell crossed with one applicable interface profile and one applicable checkpoint role.

i3_sampling_unit.definition: one base item rendered in exactly two registered variants: the registered baseline for that contrast cell, and one registered content-preserving transformed presentation of the same base item.
i3_sampling_unit.disjoint_base_items: each contrast cell draws base-item identities disjoint from every other contrast cell, so no base item contributes to two cells and the cells are not correlated through a shared stem.
i3_sampling_unit.no_cross_product: K5 and K6 are not crossed with each other and no contrast is crossed with any other contrast. There is no 32 x 3 and no 96-variant factorial expansion anywhere in this design.
i3_sampling_unit.why_pairwise: Finding S3MR-001 recorded that draft-v0.2 defined the I3 indicator over 'every applicable transformed variant' without ever fixing how many variants that is, so the estimand changed with the profile and the stratum and the same floor meant a different thing in every cell. Fixing the cluster at exactly two variants makes the estimand identical in every cell, so one floor is meaningful everywhere.

atomic_evaluation_cells.marginal_iid_with_cross_cell_dependence: every evaluation cell has an iid Bernoulli sample marginally; evaluation cells that share sampled items may be dependent, which is expressly allowed and is handled by the arbitrary-dependence bounds

pooling_prohibitions.why: K1 asks whether the model binds content to a displayed symbol; K2 asks whether it can echo trivially recoverable content at all. A high K2 rate can carry a failed K1 across a threshold, which would let the study report binding it never demonstrated.
a family the model handles well can mask a family it cannot handle, so the headroom gate would stop testing headroom
depth is the compositional variable of interest; averaging over it destroys the construct
the roles are the contrast the later study depends on
the interfaces are the object of comparison
rendering sensitivity is precisely what K6 measures

K5 varies what is inside the option list; K6 varies how the whole prompt is rendered. They are different constructs with disjoint base items, and a strong result on one would otherwise carry a failure on the other across a threshold.

pooling_prohibitions.prohibited: pooling contrast IDs within K5 or within K6
pooling_prohibitions.why: each contrast ID is a separately registered one-factor manipulation; pooling them would let an insensitive factor mask a sensitive one, which is precisely the failure I3 exists to find

pooling_prohibitions.prohibited: pooling the K5 content-position cells with the K5 correct-symbol-index cells
pooling_prohibitions.why: separating the physical position of the correct content from the identity of the displayed symbol is the entire reason the v0.1 cyclic design was withdrawn; pooling them re-creates the confound

bank_construction_policy.study2_reuse_rule: Study 3 may reuse abstract operation families only where justified in the traceability document. construction_algorithm.balancing: deterministic balancing over complete blocks of 32 base-item indices; each of the 32 baseline conditions appears exactly once per block in every contrast cell
construction_algorithm.randomness: the registered baseline nuisance state is drawn iid with exact rational weight 1/32 per state under a future seed authority that has not been granted. No seed is drawn in this round and no bank row exists. Design-time fixtures still enumerate the 32-state support exhaustively as a correctness check, which is not a sample.
construction_algorithm.status: published with the design and executable in the committed derivation script, not merely described
steps: 1. Derive the baseline condition of base-item index k as the triple (position, symbol index, alphabet index) = (k mod 4, (k div 4) mod 4, (k div 16) mod 2). Because the three factors cycle at different rates, every one of the 32 conditions occurs exactly once in each complete block of 32 consecutive base-item indices.
2. Place the correct content at the baseline position and fill the remaining three slots with the registered distractors in ascending slot order. This map from slots to content roles is a bijection.

3. Assign displayed symbols by the rotation slot -> (slot + shift) mod 4, where shift = (symbol index - position) mod 4. A rotation is a bijection on the four slots, so every displayed symbol is used exactly once and the correct content carries the intended symbol.
4. Emit the baseline variant as variant 1 of the cluster.

5. Apply the ONE registered factor of the contrast ID to the baseline triple: an offset modulo 4 on the position for K5-P1/P2/P3, an offset modulo 4 on the correct symbol index for K5-S1/S2/S3, or replacement of the alphabet for K5-A1. Re-render by steps 2 and 3 and emit the result as variant 2 of the cluster.
6. For K6, hold the entire condition triple fixed and change only the registered rendering factor, emitting R-base as variant 1 and R-sep or R-instr as variant 2.
7. Record, for each variant, the tuple (base item id, contrast family, contrast ID, position of correct content, index of the correct displayed symbol, label alphabet id, rendering id).
construction_algorithm.verification: the committed derivation script asserts, and the committed design test re-checks, that every cluster holds exactly two variants, that every contrast changes exactly one registered factor, that option/label maps are bijections, that ground truth is preserved, that baseline conditions are balanced over a complete block, and that K5 and K6 share no base-item identity

Under cyclic rotation the physical position of the correct content and the identity of the displayed symbol move together, so the design cannot attribute an effect to one rather than the other. draft-v0.1 also used the label alphabet 1/2/3/4 while the frozen answer domain is the mod-10 residues, so a displayed label could be indistinguishable from a valid answer.

counterbalancing_design.requirement: Counterbalancing must produce pre-registered PAIRWISE contrasts. Each contrast cell holds base-item contrast clusters of exactly two variants: one registered baseline and one registered one-factor transformation of it. No cross-product of factors is formed anywhere, K5 and K6 are not crossed, and base-item identities are disjoint across contrast cells.

research_question.draft_question: Can a pre-specified response and scoring interface register deliberately trivial, primitive and independently demonstrated task competence at a high JOINT-CORRECTNESS rate across registered pairs of answer-label permutations, option positions and prompt renderings, for the checkpoint roles relevant to a later J-space study?

research_question.v0_4_narrowing: draft-v0.3 asked whether competence is recovered ROBUSTLY ACROSS presentation changes, which is a presentation-effect question. Finding S3MR2-001 established that the gate statistic identifies joint correctness and not any presentation effect, so the question is narrowed to the quantity the design actually identifies. No presentation-effect estimand is claimed anywhere in draft-v0.4.
research_question.what_a_fail_would_mean: A future execution that failed would establish only that the candidate interface panel did not clear the registered gates in that realized run under the registered conditions. It would not establish model incapability and it would not prove that no population-level adequate interface exists.
research_question.what_a_pass_would_mean: A future, separately authorised execution that passed every gate would establish only that the named interface cleared the registered joint-correctness floors for the named tasks, the named checkpoint roles and the named registered presentation pairs, under the registered item-generating distributions.

conditions: the n units of the evaluation cell are the images of n iid draws from that cell's registered generator distribution
the scorer is a deterministic function of the drawn unit and the pinned checkpoint, so each unit yields exactly one Bernoulli indicator with a common success probability
no unit is redrawn, filtered, deduplicated or reordered on any post-draw property
the null and the alternative are statements about that cell's registered generating distribution
the split namespace of the cell is disjoint from every other split
exact_binomial_validity.estimand_induced_by_the_distribution: for base-item cells, the probability that a single independently drawn item is scored correct; for contrast-cluster cells, the probability that both registered variants of a single independently drawn cluster are scored correct
exact_binomial_validity.fail_closed_rule: if any gate-bearing atomic cell lacks a complete generator distribution, or would require an adaptive post-draw choice, the design fails closed for that cell. It is not silently downgraded to descriptive and no exact-binomial validity is claimed for it.
exact_binomial_validity.what_the_model_contributes: no randomness; the model is a deterministic measurement device in this design

future_seed_lifecycle.commitment_rule: each seed's hash and receipt are committed immediately, before any bank materialisation and before any model operation
future_seed_lifecycle.confirmation_seed_isolation: the confirmation seed is inaccessible until the separately authorised one-shot confirmation stage; the confirmation bank is physically absent from the build context until then
future_seed_lifecycle.domain_separation_encoding: the generator key is the registered encoding of (study identifier, protocol version, split, sampling cell identifier, draw ordinal); distinct sampling cells therefore consume disjoint key space
future_seed_lifecycle.expansion_algorithm: a deterministic cryptographic expansion with rejection sampling to the registered exact-rational weights; the implementation blob and its test vectors are frozen before the first seed draw
future_seed_lifecycle.later_disclosure: sufficient to regenerate the bank exactly, once the relevant seal permits it
future_seed_lifecycle.null_means: not yet selected; null is not zero and is not an empty bank that was drawn
future_seed_lifecycle.source: the Azure or operating-system cryptographic random source, under a separate explicit seed authority that has not been granted

rejection_contract.conditional_target_distribution: if any validity predicate ever rejected a drawn tuple, the target of the cell would be exactly the registered product distribution conditioned on the conjunction of the validity predicates, i.e. the normalised restriction of the registered distribution to the accepting set; no other conditioning is permitted
rejection_contract.why_zero: every registered support is constructed so that the validity predicates hold identically: the correct answer is drawn from the answer domain, the distractors are drawn without replacement from the answer domain minus the correct answer, and both registered label alphabets are disjoint from the answer domain. The predicates are retained as fail-closed guards, not as an active rejection step.

reuse_and_dependence_rule.consequence: every evaluation cell has an iid Bernoulli sample marginally, while evaluation cells that share sampled items may be dependent
reuse_and_dependence_rule.cross_profile_reuse: the same sampled base-item identities are reused across the applicable interface profiles for comparability
reuse_and_dependence_rule.cross_role_reuse: the same sampled base-item identities are reused across the target checkpoint roles RT, RL and RI for comparability
reuse_and_dependence_rule.dependence_is_handled_by: the arbitrary-dependence union bounds registered in power_architecture_v0_4; no independence between cells, profiles, roles or stages is used for any binding bound
reuse_and_dependence_rule.id_difference_does_not_imply_independenc: two prompts with different identifiers are not independent merely because their identifiers differ; independence is a property of the registered draw, which is why template family and every nuisance condition are themselves sampled parameters of the registered tuple

split_lifecycle.cluster_rule: Every permutation, label-set replacement and rendering variant derived from one base item belongs to the same correlated cluster as that base item, is assigned to the same split as that base item, and is never treated as an independent observation. study_identity.name: Study 3 - Interface Adequacy and Label-Binding Calibration

predecessors.relevance: Study 1 stopped because behavioral eligibility collapsed to 2/93, 2/55 and 5/90 and produced zero confirmation runs. That collapse is the single strongest motivation for treating the response interface as an object of study in its own right.

Study 2 executed its Gate A honestly and did not pass it. Its integrity is not in question. What remains unresolved is whether the A/B/C/D label-token interface it used was adequate to express competence at all.

target_must_pass_i1_i2_analysis.argument: A later study built on this interface would make claims about the target checkpoint. If the interface cannot register the target's competence on items where the answer is stated outright (I1) or on a single primitive (I2), then any later null on the target is uninterpretable in exactly the way Study 2's Gate A was. Requiring the target to clear I1 and I2 is therefore a precondition of interpretability, not a capability claim.
target_must_pass_i1_i2_analysis.consequence_if_target_fails_i1_or_i2_und: The study reports that no candidate interface was shown adequate for the target, which is a statement about the measurement panel and the target jointly, and is not evidence of model incapability.
target_must_pass_i1_i2_analysis.distinctness_from_i4: I4 is evaluated on a different checkpoint and asks a different question: can the interface register compositional competence at all. The target may legitimately fail K4 while the interface remains adequate. Conflating the two would smuggle a capability claim about the target into an instrument validation.
target_must_pass_i1_i2_analysis.position: yes, for a later target-centered causal study

task_strata.balance_invariants: the baseline nuisance state is drawn independently and uniformly at exact rational weight 1/32 per state for every base-item contrast cluster. draft-v0.3 required each consecutive group of 32 base-item indices to contain every state exactly once, which is a deterministic complete-block enumeration rather than an iid sample and cannot license an exact binomial test (S3MR2-010). n is no longer required to be a multiple of 32. Every option list remains a bijection on labels and on content roles and the registered ground truth is preserved under every registered transformation; the I0 fixtures still enumerate all 32 support states exhaustively as a design-time correctness check.

construction_algorithm.randomness: none; the construction is a deterministic function of the registered base-item index and draws no seed
construction_algorithm.status: published with the design, not merely described
steps: 2. Enumerate the four displayed symbols of the label alphabet in their registered order.
3. Form the 4 x 4 Latin square L[i][j] = (i + j) mod 4, whose rows index the position of the correct content and whose columns index the cyclic offset applied to the symbol assignment.

4. Cross the position factor with the symbol-assignment factor by taking, for each base item, the pair (p, s) where p is the physical position of the correct content and s is the index of the symbol displayed at that position. Because p and s are enumerated independently, every one of the sixteen (p, s) pairs occurs, so position and symbol identity are orthogonal rather than tied.

5. Assign the sixteen pairs to base items by the deterministic rule (p, s) = (k mod 4, (k div 4) mod 4) where k is the registered base-item index; this is a fixed function of the index and uses no random draw.
6. Cross the resulting (p, s) design with the label-alphabet factor so that each alphabet is balanced across positions and symbols.
7. Emit, for every produced variant, the tuple (base item id, position of correct content, displayed symbol at that position, label alphabet id, rendering id) as the recorded condition.
construction_algorithm.verification: the construction is checked by the committed design test, which asserts that position and symbol identity are orthogonal over a complete block and that no label symbol collides with the answer domain

counterbalancing_design.problem_in_v0_1: draft-v0.1 used four cyclic option orders. Under cyclic rotation the physical position of the correct content and the identity of the displayed symbol move together, so the design cannot attribute an effect to one rather than the other. draft-v0.1 also used the label alphabet 1/2/3/4 while the frozen answer domain is the mod-10 residues, so a displayed label could be indistinguishable from a valid answer.

task_strata.data_generating_process: Each K5 contrast cell draws its own disjoint set of base items from K1, K2 and K3 and renders each base item as a base-item contrast cluster of exactly TWO variants: the registered baseline condition for that base-item index, and one registered one-factor transformation of that baseline. Seven contrast cells are registered: K5-P1, K5-P2 and K5-P3 move only the physical position of the correct content by offsets of 1, 2 and 3 modulo 4; K5-S1, K5-S2 and K5-S3 move only the index of the correct displayed symbol by offsets of 1, 2 and 3 modulo 4; K5-A1 replaces only the label alphabet. In every cell the two factors that are not varied are held byte-identical. There is no cross-product of factors, no cyclic four-order set, and no random draw: the baseline condition is the fixed function (k mod 4, (k div 4) mod 4, (k div 16) mod 2) of the registered base-item index k, which balances all three factors over each complete block of 32 base items. The two registered label alphabets are A/B/C/D and W/X/Y/Z, both disjoint from the mod-10 answer domain and from each other; digits are forbidden as label symbols.

unresolved_operator_decisions.disposition: Exact-binomial primary design throughout. The study-level development screening level is the exact rational 1/200. The per-profile development component level is the exact rational 1/600, obtained by dividing the study-level level by the fixed selectable-profile denominator 3. Within a profile the components form an intersection-union conjunction, so no further within-profile Bonferroni correction is applied. The confirmation component level is the exact rational 1/200 on a physically disjoint one-shot split entered by exactly one pre-selected profile, so it carries no across-profile correction. Every decimal in the protocol is a rendering of the exact rational, which is the policy. The Tango paired aggregate-equivalence procedure is retired from every decision role, so no equivalence margin, critical value or discordance grid remains to be chosen. The I4 competence floor is p0 = 4/5 with p1 = 9/10, and draft-v0.4 additionally registers the binding ordering constraint that the later P3-Q competence lower bound must be at or above 19/20.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: Correct plumbing says nothing about whether any model can use the interface.
validation_targets.why_needed: If the renderer, the option-to-label mapping, or the scorer is wrong, every downstream number is uninterpretable. Study 1 and Study 2 both show that instrument faults are cheap to introduce and expensive to detect late.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: Successful binding on explicit-answer items does not show binding survives when the answer must also be computed.
validation_targets.why_needed: A model may know the answer content and still fail to emit the symbol that denotes it. Robinson, Rytting and Wingate call this multiple choice symbol binding and show it varies greatly by model.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: Agreement among surfaces does not make any of them correct.
validation_targets.why_needed: Restricted label logits, content logits, sequence log-likelihood and bounded generation are different measurement devices. Wang et al. show first-token probabilities and text answers can disagree, and that the disagreement is systematic rather than noise.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: Headroom on primitives does not predict headroom on compositions, which is exactly why a separate positive-control gate exists.
validation_targets.why_needed: If a checkpoint cannot clear a depth-1 primitive under a surface, that surface cannot support a later compositional study using the same checkpoint.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: A capable reference clearing the tasks does not show the Study 2 target can, and must not be read as a statement about the target.
validation_targets.construct: compositional task headroom in an independently capable positive control
validation_targets.why_needed: Without a checkpoint that is known on independent grounds to be able to do the compositional tasks, a null result is uninterpretable: instrument failure and model incapability are perfectly confounded. This confound is the specific reason Study 2 could not interpret its own Gate A outcome.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: A high joint-correctness rate does not show that the two marginal accuracies are equal, does not bound any presentation effect, and does not imply content sensitivity.
validation_targets.construct: joint correctness across registered answer-position and label-permutation pairs
validation_targets.v0_4_narrowing: draft-v0.3 stated this target as robustness to permutation, which requires a presentation-effect estimand the design does not identify (S3MR2-001).
validation_targets.why_needed: Pezeshkpour and Hruschka report large accuracy movement under option reordering and Zheng et al. attribute much of it to a prior over option-ID tokens. An instrument that cannot deliver a high JOINT-correctness rate over a registered position or label-permutation pair is not usable as a measurement device for the later study. This target is stated as a joint correctness level, not as a presentation-effect contrast.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: A high joint-correctness rate over the registered rendering pairs does not generalise to arbitrary prompts and makes no statement about the size or existence of a rendering effect.
validation_targets.construct: joint correctness across a small registered rendering-pair set
validation_targets.v0_4_narrowing: draft-v0.3 stated this target as robustness to rendering, which requires a presentation-effect estimand the design does not identify (S3MR2-001).
validation_targets.why_needed: Zhou et al. report that individual-question accuracy moves under meaning-preserving rewrites, particularly for smaller checkpoints. An interface that cannot deliver a high joint-correctness rate over a registered rendering pair cannot support the later study. The target is a joint correctness level over a deliberately small registered pair set, which also keeps multiplicity honest.

validation_targets.cannot_prove: The surface that agrees with the others most is not thereby the most valid; agreement is descriptive and must not be promoted into a selection rule on its own.
validation_targets.construct: agreement or disagreement among scoring surfaces
validation_targets.why_needed: Disagreement is diagnostic: it localizes whether a failure is in binding, in content access, or in generation control. Li et al. report low correlation between multiple-choice answers and long-form answers for identical questions.
